items.source: as of Spring Framework 6.0, in favor of methods defined in the SmartContextLoader SPI
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.0 起，转而使用在 SmartContextLoader SPI 中定义的方法。

items.source: Clients of a ContextLoader should call processLocations() prior to calling loadContext() in case the ContextLoader provides custom support for modifying or generating locations. The results of processLocations() should then be supplied to loadContext().
items.translation: `ContextLoader` 的客户端应在调用processLocations()之后，再调用loadContext()，以防 `ContextLoader` 提供用于修改或生成位置的自定义支持。随后，应将 `processLocations()` 的结果提供给 `loadContext()`。

items.source: NOTE: ContextLoader is a marker interface and should not be implemented directly. Implement SmartContextLoader instead of this interface in order to provide support for annotated classes, active bean definition profiles, application context initializers, and various other features not supported by methods defined in the ContextLoader SPI.
items.translation: 注意：ContextLoader 是一个标记接口，不应直接实现。请改为实现SmartContextLoader接口，以支持注解类、激活的 Bean 定义配置文件、应用程序上下文初始化器以及ContextLoader SPI 中定义的方法所不支持的各种其他功能。

items.source: Concrete implementations should register annotation configuration processors with bean factories of application contexts loaded by this ContextLoader. Beans will therefore automatically be candidates for annotation-based dependency injection using @Autowired, @Resource, and @Inject.
items.translation: 具体实现应注册注解配置处理器到由本 ContextLoader 加载的应用程序上下文的 Bean 工厂中。因此，Bean 将自动成为基于注解的依赖注入（使用 @Autowired、@Resource 和 @Inject）的候选者。

items.source: Any ApplicationContext loaded by a ContextLoader must register a JVM shutdown hook for itself. Unless the context gets closed early, all context instances will be automatically closed on JVM shutdown. This allows for freeing external resources held by beans within the context, for example, temporary files.
items.translation: 任何由 ContextLoader 加载的 ApplicationContext 必须 为其注册一个 JVM 关闭钩子。除非上下文被提前关闭，否则所有上下文实例将在 JVM 关闭时自动关闭。这可以释放由上下文中 bean 持有的外部资源，例如临时文件。

items.source:
Concrete implementations may choose to modify the supplied locations,
generate new locations, or simply return the supplied locations unchanged.
items.translation: 具体实现可以选择修改提供的路径、生成新路径，或者简单地原样返回提供的路径。

items.source:
Configuration locations are generally considered to be classpath
resources by default.
items.translation: 配置位置通常默认被视为类路径资源。

items.source: locations - the unmodified locations to use for loading the application context (can be null or empty)
items.translation: locations - 用于加载应用程序上下文的未修改位置（可以为 null 或为空）

items.source: clazz - the class with which the locations are associated: used to determine how to process the supplied locations
items.translation: clazz - 与这些位置关联的类：用于确定如何处理提供的这些位置。

items.source: locations - the resource locations to use to load the application context
items.translation: locations - 用于加载应用程序上下文的资源位置

items.source: an array of application context resource locations
items.translation: 应用程序上下文资源位置的数组

items.source: Concrete implementations must provide a public no-args constructor.
items.translation: 具体实现必须提供一个public无参构造函数。

items.source: Exception - if context loading failed
items.translation: Exception - 如果上下文加载失败
一个新的应用程序上下文
